items.title: Being flat is fpqc local on the source
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file descent.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts that flatness is fpqc local on the source (statement lines 6981-6984). The proof first reduces to a concrete algebraic statement -- for local homomorphisms A -> B -> C of local rings with B -> C flat, A -> B is flat if and only if A -> C is flat -- then proves both directions: if A -> B is flat then so is A -> C by composition, and conversely B -> C is faithfully flat so flatness of A -> C descends to A -> B (proof lines 6986-7002). The level is H2: the reduction from the geometric statement to local rings is stated, and the two directions are each given with the named algebra input.
